decision: held: neither source has open full text (24252493 J Ethnopharmacol 2014; 27912958 Complement Ther Med 2016; no PMC records), so extract standardization, doses and included trials cannot be verified; 27912958 is a pediatric systematic review without design restrictions and cannot carry adult credit. OA retry 2026-10-28: no open copy of 24252493 or 27912958.
summary: 24252493 abstract: 9 placebo-controlled trials (518 subjects) of standardized Bacopa extracts for >=12 weeks; Trail B shortened (-17.9 ms) and choice reaction time decreased, suggesting faster attention. 27912958: 5 pediatric studies with small-to-medium effects (mean d=0.42) and a call for replication.

A systematic review of the Ayurvedic medicinal herb Bacopa monnieri in child and adolescent populations.
